announcement:
Welcome to Boutique ButterLu – Personalized Picture Frames Made With Heart

We’re a family-run shop specializing in handmade, custom picture frames that help you celebrate life’s most meaningful moments. From baby announcements and baptisms to weddings, memorials, and holidays—our frames are made to hold your most cherished memories.

🎁 Looking for a gift that feels personal?
Every frame is crafted with love and designed just for you. Add names, quotes, dates, or change the colors to match your style. Just leave your details at checkout or message us with your request!

📦 Processing Time: 3–4 business days (Mon–Fri)
🚚 U.S. Shipping: Standard (2–7 business days) or Priority (2–3 business days)
🌍 International Shipping: Buyer is responsible for any customs/duties

✨ Popular Occasions We Create For:

Weddings: Bride & Groom, Parents of the Bride/Groom, Bridal Party
Family & Baby: Ultrasound Gifts, Grandparents-to-Be, Christenings, Baptisms, First Holidays
Sympathy & Memorial: Pet Loss, Loved One Tributes, Remembrance Gifts
Just Because: Home decor, nursery keepsakes, teacher gifts, best friend frames
🎉 Featured on The Knot – Best of Weddings

♻️ Made from high-quality MDF (crafted from recycled wood fibers) – a more sustainable, durable alternative to solid wood.

💕 Thank you for shopping small and supporting our family’s creative dream. We’re so glad you’re here! 💕
messageToBuyers:
Thank you so much for your order!
We’re truly honored to create something meaningful just for you.

Each item is handmade with care and attention to detail, and we can’t wait for you to see it. You’ll receive a shipping confirmation email as soon as your order is on its way!

📌 Important Reminder:
Before we begin, please double-check your personalization details on your receipt (spelling, punctuation, capitalization) and make sure your shipping address is correct.
Need to make a change? No problem—just message me ASAP and I’ll add a note to your order!

📦 Shipping Info:
All U.S. orders ship via First Class or Priority Mail (2–7 business days). Once your shipping label is created, tracking may take 24–48 hours to update.
Please know that once your package leaves my porch, delivery timing is in the hands of the postal service, and occasional delays do happen.

🌍 International Orders:
Buyers are responsible for any customs fees, taxes, or duties required by their country. These are not charged by or paid to Boutique ButterLu LLC.

Thank you again for supporting my small business. Your order truly means the world to me.

With gratitude,
Asli
ownerBio: I'm Asli — maker of custom wood frames & photo keepsakes. A mom of 4, I pour my love of beautiful, meaningful gifts into every piece. Butterlu has been my heart project since 2015. Shipping keepsakes people are proud to give and thrilled to keep. 🤍
